beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: Five money levels. Which one are you on?

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: Lots of people get stuck early. The last level pays the bills for you.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: Level one, me. Payday, and by Friday it's gone. Jar's empty again.

beats.speaker: rohan

beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: Level three: no card debt. Minimums on $3,000 at an assumed 22.8%: $3,909 in interest. Snip.

beats.speaker: priya

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: The twist? Level four doesn't need a big salary. It needs a head start.

beats.speaker: sharma

beats.speaker: sharma

beats.speaker: rohan
